data.exact_reserve_text: Following the annual independent actuarial review, the Syndicate net reserve margins above management's best estimate for the prior years were reduced in 2022 by $28m (2021:$41m increase).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Ground-up LPT providing the Aspen Group with $450m adverse development cover on Group reserves of $3.12bn at the effective date covering 2019 and prior accident years; transferred responsibility and expense of handling 2019 and prior claims to Enstar subsidiary.
Recognised gross favourable COVID-19 impact across classes (gross ultimate claims shown as negative), reducing reserves particularly in Accident & Health and Property.

named_events.loss_description: Actions taken to identify impacted policyholders and mitigate policies; further claims possible but mitigations and pricing actions taken.
Provides $450m adverse development cover on Group reserves of $3.12bn at the effective date; covers 2019 and prior accident years.
COVID-19 impact shown by class with a net favourable impact (net ultimate claims -15,072k).

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022 were GBP 1,041.0m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 32.6m (c.3.13% of opening reserves), driven by adverse development in certain older underwriting years partially offset by releases elsewhere. Management notes a $28m reduction in net reserve margins following the actuarial review (reflecting reduced uncertainty), holds an additional $12m margin for inflation, and completed a Group Loss Portfolio Transfer covering 2019 and prior which provides substantial adverse development reinsuring protection.
raw_causal_phrases: the Syndicate net reserve margins above management's best estimate for the prior years were reduced in 2022 by $28m (2021:$41m increase).

The reduction largely relates to reducing uncertainty on the financial and professional lines of business as views on the claims development patterns and the impact of remediation work done to date, including potential for future development and the impact of rate change, become more aligned.
In the current year an additional net margin of $12m is held for increased inflation above the impacts included in the management best estimate for the inflation we are seeing.
The LPT arrangement the company entered into ... provides the Aspen Group with $450m adverse development cover on Group reserves of $3.12bn at the effective date.
The LPT covers all business on the 2019 and prior accident years

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was not given explicitly as a single gross figure. A gross PYD was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative estimates by underwriting year) and therefore is subject to triangle interpretation. The managing agent narrative provides net movements (in USD) of -$28m which differ from the gross triangle-derived figure; the syndicate also executed a Loss Portfolio Transfer affecting 2019 and prior which materially influences comparability. Where only net (reinsurer-adjusted) or USD figures were present these were noted but not used as the primary gross PYD source.
